en:
Smart Port Devices

Smart Port Devices connect directly to the V5 Brain through its Smart Ports. These devices expand your robot's capabilities by enabling sensing, motion control, and advanced feedback systems.

Smart Port sensors provide real-time environmental and motion data that your robot can use for decision-making and control.

  • Inertial Sensor - Track heading, rotation, and acceleration for precise movement and orientation.
  • Rotation Sensor - Measure rotational position, direction, and speed.
  • Distance Sensor - Measure the distance between the sensor and nearby objects.
  • Optical Sensor - Detect color, brightness, and proximity to objects.
  • GPS Sensor - Determine the robot's position and heading on the field relative to the GPS Field Code.
  • AI Vision Sensor - Detect and classify objects using AI-based vision processing.
  • Vision Sensor - Detect and track color signatures within its field of view.

In addition to the devices listed above, V5 Smart Motors also connect through Smart Ports. See the Motors and Motor Controllers documentation for motor-specific APIs.
zh:
智能端口设备

智能端口 设备通过V5主控器的智能端口直接连接。这些设备通过启用传感、运动控制和高级反馈系统来扩展机器人的功能。

智能端口传感器提供实时环境和运动数据，您的机器人可将其用于决策和控制。

  • 惯性传感器- 跟踪航向角、旋转和加速度，以实现精确的运动和方向。
  • 旋转传感器- 测量旋转位置、方向和速度。
  • 距离传感器- 测量传感器与附近物体之间的距离。
  • 光学传感器- 检测颜色、亮度和物体的接近度。
  • GPS 传感器- 确定机器人在场地上相对于 GPS 场代码的位置和航向角。
  • AI 视觉传感器- 使用基于 AI 的视觉处理来检测和分类对象。
  • 视觉传感器- 检测并跟踪其视野内的颜色特征。

除了上面列出的设备外，V5智能电机还通过智能端口进行连接。有关电机特定 API，请参阅电机和电机照明文档。
